prompt: Edit this Gabriel story style test into a slightly simpler, visibly CLUMSIER BEGINNER fan drawing. Same adult tan-skinned wingless woman, long pale blonde wavy hair, grey-green tired eyes, white sailor blouse, slate collar, orange necktie, bracelets; same pose cheek in hand and other hand holding lever in pastel pink train cab with simple blue sky clouds outside. Keep identity, expression and composition. Reduce detail everywhere by about half: hair only 6-8 large uneven clumps with almost no internal strand lines; shirt as plain flat white shapes with 2 crude fold marks; tie plain orange with only two crooked cross lines implying plaid; bracelets only 3-4 oversized bead circles; simplified mitt-like hands with minimal finger lines. Head slightly oversized, eyes slightly uneven height, angular awkward elbow and narrow uneven shoulders. Thin shaky black pencil outlines with occasional gaps, retraced strokes and little overshoots, flat uneven pastel fill. Very simple eye shapes with small U pupils and no glossy rendering. Cabin becomes a few crooked rectangles, just one rectangular control and one big pink lever, no mechanical details or tiny bolts. Bell becomes a crude little outline shape. Plain sky with two lopsided cloud doodles. All objects and character must look drawn by the SAME amateur. Preserve soft cream, blonde, orange, slate, pink and cyan palette and sparse pencil grain. Less polished and less anatomical than original, but only a little more clumsy, not an extreme baby scribble, not pixel art, not professional anime. No shading or gradients, no text, no wings, no added characters or props. Landscape 16:9.
